The final step in this chain is the interaction between 3'-Methoxyglabridin and Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that the observed interactions may be biologically relevant. The mechanism involves the transport of anions across cellular membranes, which could be influenced by the activity of the voltage-dependent calcium channels. While the evidence is not definitive, the cumulative data supports a plausible pathway where Azadirachtin Q may modulate the activity of these transporters through its interaction with the intermediate compound 3'-Methoxyglabridin.
